description: This file contains unit tests for the InvokeCommandRegistry class, testing capabilities and command advertisement logic based on feature flags, as well as command lookup behavior.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods for verifying command registration and capability advertisement based on runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verifies advertised capabilities match core features when no optional features are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that capabilities include optional features when the relevant flags are set.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verifies that only core commands are advertised when optional features are disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Ensures optional commands are included when feature flags are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Checks that only supported motion commands are included based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Verifies that SMS send and search capabilities are split according to the feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Ensures SMS capabilities are included if either read or send SMS features are available.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that call log commands are excluded when call log feature is unavailable.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies call log capability is excluded when feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Ensures voice wake capability is advertised without adverting related commands.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Tests that command lookup returns correct foreground requirement metadata.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verifies command lookup returns null for unknown command strings.
